title: .github: remove the leftover cirrus cron scripts
body:
I was going through what the **Cirrus migration left behind** and found this directory still sitting there. Both workflows that used it are gone - the `rerun` one in 130bb2161 and `check_cirrus_cron.yml `in 3743b9f8, which is the same commit that deleted `.cirrus.yml`. The scripts stayed.

there is no`action.yml` in the directory so they were never usable from another repo through `uses:` either. They query the Cirrus GraphQL API with `SECRET_CIRRUS_API_KEY`, which we have nothing running against now.

I did notice #28842 for nightly cron runs is still open so cron monitoring is wanted again, but these talk to Cirrus, so I do not think they carry over.

#### Does this PR introduce a user-facing change?

```
None
```

comments.body: I kept this one to just the deletion, nothing else moved. @Luap99 @danishprakash tagging you both in case there is a reason to keep these around that I did not find.
